notes.1:
中文讲述逻辑
先定义三种配置：D为原生默认，F+偏真，F−偏假。横轴是每题CPU时间预算，纵轴是该预算内已验证解出的题数。曲线来自完整4719题矩阵，截止600秒。D解3385题，逐题选最优的VBS解3547题，净多162题。10.85%来自总PAR2降低，并不是曲线面积或解题数百分比。

English speaker script
We now have the full three-configuration baseline on the retained Anniversary 2022 collection. D uses native phasing. F-plus and F-minus prefer true and false. At 600 CPU seconds, default solves 3,385 instances. If we could choose the best configuration separately for every instance at no cost, we would solve 3,547. That is 162 additional solves and a 10.85 percent reduction in penalized runtime. This is the opportunity our selector tries to capture.

Sources
raw_data_20261110/statistics.json; vbs_preferences_20261110/all_preferences.csv
Filtering: 5,355 original entries minus 636 unsolved by all official tracks = 4,719. 14,157 configuration runs. CPU-time VBS minimizes time, not conflicts.
notes.2:
中文讲述逻辑
这张图仍用同一批T600运行，只换横轴。横轴采用log(1+conflicts)间距，所以0冲突也保留。VBS对conflicts单独逐题最小化，可能与时间VBS选择不同配置。不要把这张图说成重新运行的统一冲突预算实验，也不要把conflicts称为无条件硬件无关。8条超时轨迹缺失conflicts；已解出轨迹完整。

English speaker script
The second view uses conflicts instead of CPU seconds. It counts verified solutions as the conflict threshold increases, using only completions observed in our existing 600-second runs. We compute the virtual best separately for conflicts. It can therefore choose a different configuration from the time-based virtual best. This gives us a second view of search work, without claiming a new experiment under a conflict limit.

Sources
vbs_preferences_20261110/all_preferences.csv; START_HERE_ZH.md
notes.3:
中文讲述逻辑
无监督聚类本身不使用运行时间分组；训练数据的运行成本只用于给每个簇选相位。最初8簇，每簇平均PAR2最好的固定动作都是D。扩展到15组view/k组合，有很小的正负点估计，嵌套选出的聚类策略只有0.157%，区间跨0。准确结论是没有稳定改善，而不是所有特征都无信息，或所有扩展簇均选D。Astra看过24个带赢家的描述性例子提出结构假设，不能把该过程称为完全不看标签的发现。

English speaker script
We first asked whether formulas with similar structure prefer the same phase. We used our existing statistics and structural hypotheses proposed by Astra. The initial eight clusters all preferred D as their best fixed configuration. We then tried fifteen combinations of feature views and cluster counts. Some point estimates were slightly positive, but the selected clustering policy saved only 0.16 percent and its interval crossed zero. We did not find a stable advantage from this approach.

Sources
structural_clusters_20261110/summary.json; structural_views_20261110/summary.json; structural_views_20261110/astra/astra_proposals.md
notes.4:
中文讲述逻辑
树集成预测的是D成本减F成本，正数表示F有希望省时。对每种F取三个训练seed模型预测中的最小值，再比较较大的F收益是否超过内层验证确定的margin；不够就D。42维是静态公式统计，linear42是输入名，模型本身是非线性的ExtraTrees，不是单棵小树。参数：每模型256树、深度至多12、min leaf4；实际完整候选约49万节点，因此不说模型很小。

English speaker script
Supervised learning asks a different question. Instead of assigning one phase to an entire structural cluster, we predict how much each forced phase could save relative to D for this formula. The model is an ExtraTrees ensemble using forty-two static statistics. For each forced phase, we take the minimum prediction across three training seeds. We switch only if the predicted saving exceeds a margin calibrated on inner validation data. Otherwise we retain default phasing.

Sources
research-state.yaml:R12_linear42_positive_evidence_clarification; src/anniversary2022_baseline/materialize_linear42_candidate.py
notes.5:
中文讲述逻辑
2.097677%是R12的已记录混合五折OOF证据，原query费计入，尚未覆盖全部输入采集费。平均PAR2从392.54265降至384.30838；解出3419，比D多34。名义区间1.4608到2.9407只作描述性，不是反复选择后的独立确认。补1024实测compact费用并对45个采集失败付费D后是1.9603%，解3417，余3695费用未知。不能称完整部署净加速或严格下界。

English speaker script
On the mixed development folds, the supervised selector reduces penalized runtime by about 2.10 percent relative to D. It solves 3,419 instances, compared with 3,385 for default. The free virtual best offers 10.85 percent, so this captures only part of the available opportunity. We include recorded query costs. However, input acquisition costs are still incomplete. Adding the first 1,024 measured cases gives about 1.96 percent in the partial replay. We are not yet claiming a complete deployment speedup.

Sources
research-state.yaml:R12_linear42_positive_evidence_clarification; linear42_bounded_prefetch_cost
notes.6:
中文讲述逻辑
保留2%的正证据，同时明确其条件。结构混合下模型见过相近区域；coarse/fine留组后分别只有0.37085%和−0.26081%。这不是证明所有监督学习不可能迁移，也不是说有独立test。结构分组不是problem-family标签，未使用应用family作为输入。

English speaker script
The two-percent result has an important boundary. Mixed folds separate equivalent instances, but similar structural regions appear in both training and evaluation. When we hold out larger structural groups, the saving falls to 0.37 percent. Under the finer grouping it becomes a small loss. This supports a conditional prediction signal within represented regions, while transfer to new structures remains unresolved.

Sources
research-state.yaml:R12_linear42_positive_evidence_clarification
notes.7:
中文讲述逻辑
使用附件名称Astra。我们不把未指明的LLM权重论文写成支持本实验的证据，只说明借鉴读权重的想法并直接检查保存树。Astra完成7条规则解释，不能宣称完整忠实压缩。R26选特征1(log clause count)和16(dual-Horn fraction)，阈值在各训练折内重拟合；加第三个条件为balance-clause entropy。图中仅展示模板，不捏造全局统一阈值。

English speaker script
To obtain a small rule that we could apply and inspect directly, we asked Astra to inspect the saved ensemble. It returned seven candidate rules. One concrete template combines the number of clauses with the fraction of dual-Horn clauses, then selects F-plus inside that region and D otherwise. We refit the thresholds within each training fold. Reading a model can suggest hypotheses, but a readable rule still has to retain the original cost advantage when evaluated.

Sources
research-state.yaml:astra_linear42_interpretation,R26_astra_rule; src/anniversary2022_baseline/score_astra_small_fplus.py
notes.8:
中文讲述逻辑
四行不能写成相同费用条件：原森林含query费，简化模型是免费feature/query筛选。即使给简化模型免费条件，R26仅0.1717%，R31仅0.4931%，R32仅0.4401%，都没有保住2%。这些是模型压缩/可解释化结果，而不是所有简单规则不可能的证明。当前下一步优先补齐原候选采集费、冻结候选并选择新的独立测试人口。

English speaker script
The compact candidates have not retained the ensemble gain. The two-condition template gives about 0.17 percent, the readable tree about 0.49 percent, and the directional small rules about 0.44 percent. Those compact screens even assume free features and queries, so they do not reproduce the original two-percent result. Our current conclusion is that there is a predictive signal, but we do not yet have a simple rule that preserves it or a demonstrated transfer result.

Sources
research-state.yaml:R12_linear42_positive_evidence_clarification,R26_astra_rule,R31_interpretable_two_percent,R32_interpretable_soft_rules
notes.9:
中文讲述逻辑
协作者验证原始日志、模型、证明；这个包是本地导入快照，未重查全部原件。全2022已被反复用于开发，因此不能称独立最终测试。筛选636来自官方所有赛道均未解，而不是我们自己的赢家筛选。

English speaker script
These are the precise data and timeout conventions. The filtered population contains 4,719 instances and three configurations per instance. All reported percentages use the same penalized-runtime definition. We retained the all-timeout cases in scoring. The entire collection is development data, and the original source logs and certificates were verified by the collaborator rather than rechecked in this slide preparation.

Sources
START_HERE_ZH.md; raw_data_20261110/statistics.json; research-state.yaml
notes.10:
中文讲述逻辑
这页补齐无监督负结论的范围，避免说每种特征每个簇D永远最好。表格直接列15个实际候选的混合OOF点估计。未按这张表挑一个最大值当独立确认。

English speaker script
The expanded screen includes size, clause width, sign, graph and combined views at twelve, twenty-four and forty-eight clusters. Some entries have small positive point estimates. But the nested selection result remains close to zero, with an interval spanning both gain and loss.

Sources
structural_views_20261110/summary.json
notes.11:
中文讲述逻辑
本页用于问答，不在主线额外重复全部结论。R33仅完成提取未评分，不放收益榜。完整独立测试另选，不复用已反复研究的2022。

English speaker script
The immediate next step is to finish pricing input acquisition for the original candidate. We should then freeze the selection procedure and evaluate it on a separate collection. The present evidence supports a conditional prediction signal, not yet a complete deployed or transferable speedup.
